title: Manyhands JSON v1 setup cancel
description: The data of a repo setup-cancel: the setup it ended, what became of its branches, and whether a first-time setup's registration was removed. The setup's own request was finished as cancelled in the same transaction. It holds no remote location, credential or identity.

type.description: Always setup_cancel: the tag that tells this data from every other command's.

kind.description: enable for a first-time setup, change for a change of an enabled repository's setting.

remote_branch.description: deleted: the setup's branch was deleted from the remote at its recorded commit. absent: the remote had none. kept: the remote's branch is at another commit than the recorded one, and was left. not_published: the setup was never pushed, and nothing was connected to.

local_branch.description: deleted: the local setup branch was deleted at its recorded commit. absent: there was none. kept: it is at another commit than the recorded one, and was left.

unregistered.description: True when the setup was a first-time one and the repository was taken out of the repository list.
